tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. The calm "desk" every screen sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, the answer sheet, list rows. Sits on `paper`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Quiet panels: the question summary, chips, the timer pill, table header.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card and list borders, dividers between rubric rows, progress track. Decorative only.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons: 3.2:1+ on `paper` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `paper`, `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `highlight` (13:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, metadata, AI notes. 5.6:1+ on every ground incl. `highlight`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Desk Ink, the primary brand color: primary buttons, links, the selected answer, the human score frame, the wordmark tile.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `primary` fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` / `primary-hover` (10:1+).

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Marker, the secondary brand color: the logo highlight, the cover, small brand moments. A fill, never text.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Evidence fill: the student's own words that the AI points to. `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: highlight-rule
tokens.usage: The 3px left rule of an evidence quote; marks quoted student text and nothing else (3.4:1+).

tokens.name: met
tokens.usage: "Met" text and icon; scored count. On `met-bg` or `surface` (6:1+).

tokens.name: met-bg
tokens.usage: "Met" badge fill; high-confidence chip fill.

tokens.name: partial
tokens.usage: "Partly met" text; medium confidence. On `partial-bg` or `surface`.

tokens.name: partial-bg
tokens.usage: "Partly met" badge fill; medium-confidence chip fill.

tokens.name: flag
tokens.usage: "Needs a closer look": flag text, icon and callout border. On `flag-bg` or `surface`.

tokens.name: flag-bg
tokens.usage: Flag callout fill; low-confidence chip fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors: failed AI call, invalid score, rubric line errors. On `danger-bg` or `surface`.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Error callout fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px (3:1+ on `paper` and `surface`).
